# PLAN — iteration 3
## Current state assessment
The verified incumbent is timing-feasible at 7 LUTs and 9 FFs, so promotion requires a strict LUT reduction, or equal LUTs with fewer FFs. Iterations 1 and 2 were rejected: narrowing the counter and truncating the comparison both changed defined high-bit behavior. Top numeric latency is unknown; no annotation is required.

## Hypothesis
At the terminal count of 255, incrementing already produces zero in the low byte, so clearing only the incremented upper bits may remove redundant clear-versus-increment selection logic and reduce LUTs without changing behavior.

## Instruction for generator
Keep the 32-bit counter, full-width comparison, reset, and registered `pwm_out` behavior. Replace the terminal-count clear-versus-increment update with an unconditional 32-bit increment, then explicitly clear only `counter[31:8]` when the old counter equals 32'd255; at that count the increment already makes `counter[7:0]` zero. Preserve the full 32-bit PWM comparison and all reset and cycle behavior, including for counter values above 255.
